# GRANDstack

> GraphQL on Neo4j for developers and agents. A Neo4j database, a GraphQL server generated from a schema file (`@neo4j/graphql` v7 on GraphQL Yoga), and a typed React app, run together with Docker Compose. The sample is a movie and people search, compare and edit app. The default stack has no authentication; an opt-in setup adds Keycloak login, a gateway and row-level rules. Do not expose either publicly.

The project is four repositories kept side by side in one folder: `grandstack` (this one: compose, overview, tutorial, agent guide), `grandstack-server`, `grandstack-web` and `grandstack-auth` (optional auth). Each has its own `docs/` folder.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](docs/agents.md): mental model, where to change what, verification checklist, gotchas
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): components, data model, request flow, design decisions
- [Build your own app](docs/build-your-own-app.md): replace the data and build a typed front end (worked example: Books)

## Diagrams

Annotated architecture diagrams are SVG files in each repository's `docs/diagrams/` folder (for this repository: system overview, data model, and the default-versus-auth comparison). Every figure is embedded with a numbered text legend, so the same information is available without viewing the image.

## This repository

- [README](README.md): quickstart and documentation map
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): compose services, ports, settings, Podman, resetting data
- [Versioning and releases](docs/versioning-and-releases.md): tags, what is released, how to cut a release
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): phase status; planned (not built yet): agents and MCP, federation, site
